title: Warm Cheesy Mediterranean Cheddar Cheese Wrap
description: A kid-friendly Mediterranean dish featuring cheddar cheese and a bitter twist, wrapped in a ssam-wrap for a fun and easy meal. This dish is perfect for a quick lunch or snack.
instructions: Preheat a panini press or grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Spread a tablespoon of hummus on each ssam-wrap.
Top the hummus with a quarter cup of shredded cheddar cheese.
Add sliced cucumber, diced tomato, and thinly sliced red onion on top of the cheese.
Sprinkle pitted kalamata olives and canned artichoke hearts over the vegetables.
Fold the bottom half of the ssam-wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Place the wraps in the panini press or grill and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the wrap is crispy.
Serve the wraps warm and enjoy.
Let the wraps cool for a minute or two before serving to kids.
Cut the wraps in half for a fun and easy snack or lunch.
